statement: Fix a clearing stage with parameter t. Consider the finite sequence of its committed numerical states: the initial post-sweep state, indexed by 0, and the states after successive successful clearings, indexed by a = 1, . . . , kmax. Failed trials leave this numerical sequence unchanged. Let Aa ⊂ Aa−1 be the active sites after operation a, put Oa = Aa−1 \ Aa, and let Ta be the complement of Aa in the physical torus. At each index use the physical state of Section 2: the sites in Ta have their exact true potentials, the sites in Aa have their current partial potentials, and M(a) is the real terminal- Schur matrix. The relevant true terminal principal matrices are invertible at the fixed energy. Use the restriction of one frozen vector r at every index, with p = ℑr bounded above and 68 below by positive constants, and write g(a) = (M(a) − t diag(r|Aa ))−1 , h(a) = √ t g(a) , K (a) ij = (h (a) ij )2 , F (a) ij = |h (a) ij |2 .
